standard_prerequisites.name: Differential graded algebra and dg module
standard_prerequisites.statement: A differential graded algebra A is a graded algebra with a differential of degree one satisfying the Leibniz rule, and a dg A-module is a graded module with a compatible differential.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the ambient category in which all the modules, morphisms and shifts live (source lines 1286-1288 and throughout the proof).

standard_prerequisites.name: Admissible monomorphism and its cokernel
standard_prerequisites.statement: A morphism of dg modules is admissible when it fits into a short exact sequence of graded modules that splits as graded modules; its cokernel then carries an induced differential making the cone a distinguished triangle.
standard_prerequisites.use: The hypothesis makes alpha and beta admissible, which produces the left inverses, the cokernels Q_i and hence the distinguished triangles (source lines 1295-1300, 1316-1318).

standard_prerequisites.name: Axiom TR4 (octahedral axiom)
standard_prerequisites.statement: Given distinguished triangles (K,L,Q_1), (L,M,Q_3) and (K,M,Q_2) built from two composable morphisms, TR4 asserts that the connecting morphism Q_3 -> Q_1[1] can be chosen so that the three triangles form the octahedral diagram.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the conclusion: the proof produces exactly such a structure at source lines 1335-1340.

core_obligations: Choose left inverses: split alpha and beta as graded modules, obtain pi_1 left inverse to alpha and pi_3 left inverse to beta, set pi_2 = pi_1 composed with pi_3, and observe that K -> M is admissible with left inverse pi_2 (source lines 1295-1299).

Identify the cokernels and split the middle module: show Q_1 = Ker(pi_1), Q_3 = Ker(pi_3) and Q_2 = Ker(pi_2), deduce the direct sum decompositions L = K direct sum Q_1, M = L direct sum Q_3 and M = K direct sum Q_1 direct sum Q_3, and conclude Q_2 = Q_1 direct sum Q_3 because pi_2 vanishes on both summands (source lines 1299-1306).

Build the morphisms of triangles and verify the TR4 datum: display the three-row diagram of admissible short exact sequences, note that the downward maps are compatible with the chosen splittings and hence give morphisms of the distinguished triangles, use the splitting of the bottom row to get a splitting of 0 -> Q_1 -> Q_2 -> Q_3 -> 0, and compute the connecting morphism delta : Q_3 -> Q_1[1] as the composite Q_3 -> L[1] -> Q_1[1], which is the required structure (source lines 1307-1340).

proof_roadmap.step: Take left inverses pi_1, pi_3, form pi_2, and note K -> M is admissible.
Identify the three cokernels with the kernels of the left inverses and split M as K direct sum Q_1 direct sum Q_3, giving Q_2 = Q_1 direct sum Q_3.
Draw the three-row diagram, check the downward arrows are compatible with the splittings, and obtain morphisms of the three distinguished triangles.
Use the splitting of the bottom sequence to compute delta as Q_3 -> L[1] -> Q_1[1], producing the TR4 structure.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-two-split-injections at source lines 1285-1292: for a differential graded algebra A and admissible monomorphisms of dg A-modules alpha : K -> L and beta : L -> M, there are distinguished triangles (K,L,Q_1), (K,M,Q_2) and (L,M,Q_3) for which the octahedral axiom TR4 holds. The proof at source lines 1294-1341 is a construction rather than a citation: it chooses left inverses pi_1 and pi_3 for the two admissible monomorphisms, builds the composite left inverse pi_2, identifies the three cokernels with the kernels of the left inverses, exhibits the resulting direct-sum decompositions Q_2 = Q_1 direct sum Q_3, displays the three-row commutative diagram of admissible short exact sequences, argues that the downward arrows are compatible with the chosen splittings and therefore define morphisms of the corresponding distinguished triangles, and finally computes that the connecting morphism delta of the split triangle is the composite Q_3 -> L[1] -> Q_1[1], which is exactly the TR4 datum. Every step is a separate compatibility check and the statement mentions none of them. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
